column1: # Target height in metres per installed character, for height_check_installed.py.
# Transcribed from the "Known per-model arguments" table in README.md. It is a
# DATA FILE in the repo on purpose: a hand-written mapping that lives only in a
# session is lost, and this project has already paid for that once -- Gordon
# Freeman's viseme map was not in his recipe row, so the next rebuild silently
# dropped all 32 of his morph targets with every census count unchanged.
# Four rows of that table name two characters at once and are split here:
#   "Clone troopers"           -> Clone Trooper 501st, Clone Trooper Shiny
# and two are named differently in the table than on disk:
# A character with NO row here is not a pass and not a failure -- it is
# unmeasurable, because no target was ever written down for it. The tool prints
# "-" for those and judges them on the detached-mesh half only.
# 52 rows below, and 52 of the 65 installed characters match one. The 13 that
# do not are the characters whose source archive was never located, so no
# target was ever chosen for them: Adachi Rei, Baby Groot, Doom Slayer, Harq
# Alkahana, Hatsune Miku (Retry Now ver.), Hatsune Miku (Dark) (Retry Now
# ver.), Inforder Trogen, Iron Man Mark 85, K-2SO, Kaiser Aufhaenger, Skeleton
# 52 + 13 = 65. If that stops adding up, a name here has drifted from a name on
# disk and the tool is silently judging fewer characters than it reports.
